title: Congressman Mark Messmer recognizes farmers, honors Navy birthday, invites IN-08 residents for assistance
text:

Congressman Mark Messmer recognizes farmers, honors Navy birthday, invites IN-08 residents for assistance
Congressman Mark Messmer used his X account in October to salute Hoosier farmers on National Farmers Day (October 12), commemorate the U.S. Navy's anniversary (October 13), and invite Indiana's eighth district residents to seek help from his...
Congressman Mark Messmer, who represents Indiana’s 8th congressional district, posted a series of messages on his official X account in mid-October 2026. The posts included greetings for National Farmers Day, a tribute to the United States Navy’s anniversary, and an invitation for constituents to seek assistance with federal agencies.
On October 12, Messmer recognized local agricultural workers with a post reading: "Happy National Farmers Day! Today and every day, I’m proud to stand with the hardworking Hoosier farmers who make Indiana and America strong!"
The following day, he marked the founding of the U.S. Navy with another message: "Happy 251st Birthday to the United States Navy! For more than two and a half centuries, America’s sailors have defended our freedom and protected our nation across the globe. Thank you to every sailor, past and present, for your service!" This message coincided with nationwide celebrations of the Navy's establishment in 1775.
On October 15, Messmer addressed residents of Indiana’s 8th district directly: "Calling all #IN08 residents! Do you need help with a federal agency? Come to one of my office's Constituent Casework Service Meetings! Staff will be available to meet with you one-on-one to discuss and help you with your case. Call my office at (812) 465-6484 for more info!" Such outreach efforts are part of routine constituent services offered by members of Congress.
Messmer has served as U.S. Representative since January 2025 after previously holding positions in Indiana state government. His social media activity often highlights local events and opportunities for direct engagement with his office.
